column1: # SPEC-REGISTRY.tsv — where every acceptance spec actually runs.
# Enforced by test/acceptance-spec-coverage.bats (CI stage 1c). Adding a spec
# to this directory without adding a row here is a stage-1c failure, and so is
# a row whose claim disagrees with playwright.config.ts, the Makefile, or
# Commit d9d1d2f rewrote a test in smoke.spec.ts to assert the Collusion &
# Access page carries no page-specific background. Nothing enforced it: at that
# point smoke.spec.ts appeared in no CI stage and no make target, so the
# assertion could regress silently and forever. It was not the only one — of 15
# specs on disk, CI ran exactly one.
# Worse, four specs matched no `testMatch` in playwright.config.ts at all, so
# they ran nowhere, not even under a bare `make acceptance-test`. Playwright
# does not warn about a spec no project claims; it simply reports a smaller
# total. `bunx playwright test --list` on 978dfea says "70 tests in 12 files"
# against 16 files on disk, and nothing draws attention to the missing four.
# This is the same defect class as the dashboard vitest suite (fixed by CI
# stage 1b) and as the missing junit reporter documented in
# playwright.config.ts: a missing input degrades to nothing rather than to an
# error. The suite passes; it just proves less than the reader believes.
# TESTING.md already described this coverage in prose, and had already drifted:
# it says "68 tests across 9 specs, in four projects" while the config now has
# six projects and Playwright reports 70 tests in 12 files. Prose cannot fail a
# build. Every column below is cross-checked against the artefact that actually
# decides, in both directions, so a stale row is as loud as a missing one.
#   spec     Filename in this directory. Must exist; every *.spec.ts here must
#   runner   Where it runs automatically. One of:
#              make:<target>  A specific make target documented in Makefile
#              suite-only     Matches a project in playwright.config.ts, but is
#                             not wired into a CI stage. Runs under `make
#              unwired        Matches NO project in playwright.config.ts. Does
#                             not run anywhere, not even under a bare
#                             in both directions, so a spec cannot be marked
#                             unwired once it is wired, or stay marked
#                             suite-only after being dropped from the config.
#   reason   Required for everything except ci:*. Why it is not in a CI lane.
#            "it just isn't" is not a reason; name the blocking precondition,
#            because that sentence is the work item for wiring it in later.
# Tab-separated. Comments start with #. Order is alphabetical by spec.

column3: reason

Every test is behind guards.afmDeployed(); the CI lane never runs `make demo-k8s-afm-up`, so all 11 would SKIP. A stage of 11 skips is a green light that proves nothing, which is worse than an absent stage because it reads as coverage.
Same guards.afmDeployed() precondition as afm-frontend: 9 tests, all SKIP without the k8s-afm slice. Wire in only alongside deploying that slice in the lane.
Drives agent detail pages to assert activity events are rendered. Requires running demo cluster with kagent or signal-ingest.
Drives dual-agent claim workflow and comparative telemetry on /agents. Requires demo-signalloom-up.
Drives agent trust topology inspector links, query selectors, instance banners, and cross-application links. Requires demo-signalloom-up.

Two preconditions keep it out of a CI lane. (1) Its playwright.config.ts project is gated on AMXD_DEMO_CONSOLE, for the reason the docs project is gated on DOCS_BASE_URL: scripts/acceptance-test.sh runs with no --project, so an unconditional project would be claimed by `make acceptance-test` and redden a lane that has nothing to do with it. (2) The precondition itself is a dashboard IMAGE built from this branch. `make demo-signalloom-up` runs `signalloom-images`, which builds the dashboard from the tree, but the one on the demo cluster predates this console: probed 2026-09-15, its bundle carries 0 matches for AgentMaxxingDemoPage and lists 33 lazy page chunks, none of them this page, while App.tsx:436 registers the route in source. `make demo-agentmaxxing-ui-test` supplies AMXD_DEMO_CONSOLE and runs both the AMXO vitest timeline tests and this Playwright acceptance spec.
Drives Weave dashboard to verify Layer 6 Cloud Control Plane threads, blind spot bs-004 resolution, and audit metadata drawer. Requires demo-signalloom-up.

Probes Grafana (13000), Archivista (18082) and the Olly portal (18080) — three services the CI lane does not deploy, and three port-forwards the TEST-1 branch of scripts/acceptance-test.sh does not create. HUMAN_VALIDATION.md's 2026-07-26 baseline records 4 of its 8 tests failing purely on service availability.

SLCD-P6-3 / P6-4. Needs NO cluster: it spawns `bun harness/coding-agents-server.ts` on --port 0 and drives the real CodingAgentsTab against it, so it runs on a laptop in well under a minute. Its precondition is bun on PATH, test/acceptance/node_modules (react + react-dom, already in package.json for the streaming harness), and a Chromium Playwright can launch — PW_CHANNEL=chromium if /opt/google/chrome/chrome is not executable in your shell. Target `make demo-signalloom-coding-agent-topology` executes this acceptance suite independently. Unlike docs and agentmaxxing-demo-console its project is NOT env-gated, because its precondition IS satisfied wherever `make acceptance-test` already runs; gating it would only hide it. Its project deliberately carries no storageState and no `setup` dependency, which would reintroduce the cluster requirement it exists to avoid.

Both tests test.skip() unless the live estate already holds an enrolled/active agent with a UUID-shaped agent_registry id. A freshly built CI cluster has none, so this contributes 2 skips. It needs a seeding step before it can mean anything in a lane.

Targets the Estate 95 win95 console at http://127.0.0.1:8675 (`make console`), a different application from the Signal Loom dashboard every other spec drives. It needs no cluster and no gateway, so it does not belong in any of the current projects — it wants a project of its own with `make console` as its precondition.
Drives Distance & Latency page against live API. Requires running demo cluster.

Renders the four SLON-P3-1 docs pages in Chromium against a locally served build of this tree. Its precondition is a built dist on DOCS_BASE_URL, which demo-signalloom-up does not provide, so its project is gated on that variable and the make target supplies it.
Drives Feeds & FrostDB Explorer to verify 6-layer catalog health, multidimensional slicing/dicing, FrostDB pushdown workbench, bounded streaming, and Arrow proof drawer. Requires demo-signalloom-up.
Drives the /agents page against the live Kagent declarative swarm; requires the kagent slice (make demo-kagent-up).

Walks every data-driven route with demo fixtures DISABLED and fails on any 4xx/5xx from an API call. Runs in stage8b beside smoke.spec.ts because both are `smoke`-project specs that log themselves in; stage8b passes both filenames, since acceptance-test.sh forwards "$@" to playwright as a filename filter and a spec not named there never runs.
Drives the 3-tier sidebar navigation hierarchy (View, Control, Design), persistent utility anchors, active highlighting, keyboard shortcuts, and rail collapse. Requires demo-signalloom-up.
Drives the 3-step first user onboarding wizard flow with persistence and consent. Requires running demo cluster with dashboard-signalloom.
Behind guards.afmDeployed(). One test, SKIP without the k8s-afm slice.

Asserts 7-hop complete authorization chain, completeness badge, and instant proof drawer drill-down in Agent Dossier Tabs 2 and 5 against live demo cluster.
Drives Weave dashboard to verify OpenBao cryptographic identity audit stream panel, SVID lease tracking, and out-of-role vault access filtering.
Drives Weave dashboard to verify live eBPF Sentinel status bar, provider breakdown badges, and fail-closed telemetry gap alert banner. Requires demo-signalloom-up.

Three of its four tests re-prove Dex login/logout, which stage 8 already covers via signalloom-test-1.spec.ts's Dex contracts; the fourth needs AFM. Cheap, and the best candidate for the next stage — but adding it today buys duplicate coverage rather than new coverage.
Dedicated rapid demo smoke suite (<90s) for live partner walk-throughs verifying user onboarding wizard and dual-agent claim/telemetry flows. Requires running demo cluster with dashboard-signalloom.

Its project sets a 30-minute test timeout. CI_STAGE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS is 900, so a passing run would be killed mid-flight and reported as a stage failure. It also drives instructor phases that mutate one shared cluster, which is why its project sets retries:0.

Needs the SuperCred demo to have been driven first, and needs the storageState the setup project writes. Adding it to the `smoke` project would silently run it unauthenticated — playwright.config.ts documents exactly that trap. It needs its own project with dependencies:["setup"].

Needs no cluster and runs in ~25s, so unlike its siblings it is not BLOCKED from a lane — it is simply not in one yet, and that is the work item. It belongs beside stage 1b/1c as a cheap guard ahead of ~25 minutes of cluster work; wiring it needs a run_stage in scripts/ci/vm-pipeline.sh plus `bunx playwright install chromium` on the CI image, neither of which is in this branch's scope. Its project deliberately has no storageState and no `setup` dependency: depending on setup would reintroduce the cluster requirement it exists to avoid, and test-results/.auth-state.json does not exist on a machine that has never run against one.

Drives a reset and a full phase against the live estate; its project sets a 15-minute timeout, at or above the 900s CI stage cap, so CI would kill a healthy run. retries:0 because both runs mutate one shared cluster and a retry would start against its own leftovers. Same shape as supercred-two-window.
Seeds the superadmin flag before app boot and needs the SuperCred demo deployed. Same storageState problem as supercred-live-pages: the `smoke` project would run it logged out.

Drives two browser contexts against a demo that mutates one shared cluster, and its project sets a 15-minute timeout — at or above the 900s CI stage cap, so CI would kill a healthy run. retries:0 for the same mutation reason, so a single flake fails the lane outright.
30-minute project timeout against the 900s CI stage cap, same as supercred-evidence-lifecycle. It runs all five phases, resets, then reruns them — the longest single test in the repo.
Drives tenant warning notifications and audit linking across dual tenants. Requires demo-signalloom-up.
Drives Weave dashboard to verify Who Authorized This Action 7-hop authorization query, completeness badge, GitOID attestation, and >=90% complete chain KPI. Requires demo-signalloom-up.
